chunks: Ya'qub ibn Shu'ayb asked him about a woman wearing jewelry. He said:
"She may wear the masak and the two anklets."

key_terms.الْمَرْأَةِ: the woman; the legal subject being asked about
key_terms.الْمَسَكَ: masak; a type of ornament worn by women
key_terms.تَلْبَسُ: she wears; indicating permissibility in this context

ai.seo_question: What jewelry may a woman wear while in ihram according to this hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling about what kind of jewelry a woman may wear in the state of ihram. It indicates permissibility for specific adornments mentioned in the report, making it relevant to the fiqh of hajj and ihram restrictions.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.2637 - Ya'qub ibn Shu'ayb asked Imam (as) about a woman wearing jewelry while in Ihram.
Imam (as) said: "She may wear anklets (masak) and bracelets (khalkhalayn)."
